name: Fallujah
pointBasis: Exact WUP2025 settlement point; not shifted and not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Iraqi Ministry of Justice publishes a dedicated Fallujah real-estate registration directorate and its official service/news pages identify the Ministry's real-estate registration directorates as the provider of property deed/map services. This establishes local registry custody, not open parcel geometry or citywide digital coverage.
technicalBlocker: No safe anonymous first-party response containing a stable native parcel identifier and complete polygon was verified. The Ministry's public property deed/map service describes an owner-submitted information service and states that online availability is currently limited to Baghdad; the Ministry article and Ur Portal pages exposed no public parcel feature endpoint, schema, CRS, or bounded anonymous geometry response. No login, credentials, token, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe property field request was used.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local registry custody and a public description of a property deed/map request service; no anonymous parcel feature response verified.

remainingUncertainty: The Fallujah directorate's internal cadastral maps and records may exist without an anonymous public GIS interface. The Ur Portal service page's Baghdad availability statement does not prove that Fallujah has no digital coverage. The exact WUP point was not shifted; no exact-point hit or map-extent miss was used as evidence of citywide absence.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently check for a first-party anonymous native parcel endpoint or a newly enabled Fallujah Ur service before any adapter qualification; keep runtime held.
